header: The opening band, closing on figures
lead: Two to four numbers under the copy, each with its own label and an optional unit. Every figure is set at one optical size with lining digits, so a four-figure count never dwarfs a percentage beside it.

metrics.title: Figures, minimum
metrics.text: Fewer than two is a sentence, not a row.

metrics.title: Figures, maximum
metrics.text: More than four and none of them is read.

metrics.title: Optical size
metrics.text: The same for every figure, whatever its digit count.
